opening.argument: The presentation ties CoinVegas packages to unusually large earnings claims, stating that one person can earn “up to 70,000 euros per week on one account” while urging members to expand an international network. It also projects that the coin’s value will reach “between 12.5 to 15 euros per coin” within one year. The proposed payment pathway involves submitting a deposit or bank transfer for account activation, followed by an activation gift code, while viewers are directed to purchase event tickets and associate VIP tickets with receiving a MasterCard. Although the presentation includes compliance framing and acknowledges uncertainty about future value, these promised values, payments, activations, and cards are not established as delivered.
